question: 平台目前一共注册了多少位客户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers
notes: 最基础的计数，基线必须做对；gold 结果 1 行。

question: 目前在售的商品一共有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS on_sale_products FROM products WHERE status = '在售'
notes: 考察是否注意到商品有在售/下架状态；gold 1 行。

question: 客户数量最多的 10 个城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC, city ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 城市维度 TopN；gold 10 行。

question: 已完成订单的平均订单金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'
notes: 平均值口径，注意排除已取消订单；gold 1 行。

question: 各会员等级分别有多少位客户？
gold_sql: SELECT member_level, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY member_level ORDER BY customer_count DESC
notes: 4 个会员等级；gold 4 行。

question: 全部商品中，哪个品类的平均标价最高？平均标价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 1
notes: 品类均价排序取第一；gold 1 行。

question: 已取消的订单有多少笔？占全部订单的比例是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已取消' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = '已取消' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancel_rate_pct FROM orders
notes: 取消率，两列一行；gold 1 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月一共成交了多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%'
notes: 月度计数，日期是 TEXT 需要 LIKE 或区间；gold 1 行。

question: 全部时间内，各销售渠道分别有多少笔订单（包含已取消）？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY order_count DESC
notes: 6 个销售渠道；gold 6 行。

question: 投放预算最高的 5 个计划名称、投放渠道和预算分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT campaign_name, channel, budget FROM campaigns ORDER BY budget DESC, campaign_id ASC LIMIT 5
notes: 活动计划预算 Top5；gold 5 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的 GMV 分别是多少？按 GMV 从高到低排列。
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 渠道 GMV，口径=已完成订单成交额；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各商品品类卖出了多少件、销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
notes: 订单明细×商品×订单三表；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月销售额最高的 10 个商品是哪些？显示商品名称和销售额。
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS sales_amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY sales_amount DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 商品维度 TopN；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月哪些省份的客户贡献的 GMV 最高？列出前 10 个省份及 GMV。
gold_sql: SELECT c.province, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.province ORDER BY gmv DESC, c.province ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 订单×客户按省份聚合；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各会员等级的平均订单金额（客单价 = 该等级 GMV ÷ 已完成订单数）分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY aov DESC
notes: 客单价=GMV/订单数（订单口径，不是除以客户数），题面已写死口径；gold 4 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY aov DESC
notes: 渠道客单价；虽然只查一张表，但归在多表口径组；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月退货金额最高的 10 个商品是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM returns r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.return_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY refund_amount DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 按退货发生月份统计退款金额；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品牌的 GMV 是多少？列出前 10 个品牌。
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY gmv DESC, p.brand ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 品牌维度 Top10；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年以来各投放渠道的广告预算和带来的归因 GMV 分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH campaign_gmv AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.channel, ROUND(SUM(c.budget), 2) AS total_budget, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(g.gmv), 0), 2) AS attributed_gmv FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN campaign_gmv g ON g.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.start_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY attributed_gmv DESC
notes: 预算要先按计划聚合再按渠道汇总，直接 join 订单会把预算乘行数；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月客单价最高的 10 个城市是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY aov DESC, c.city ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 城市客单价 Top10，小城市容易因订单少而虚高，考察是否理解口径；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月不同年龄段的客户各有多少人、贡献多少 GMV？按 18-25 岁、26-35 岁、36-45 岁、46 岁及以上分组。
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 THEN '18-25岁' WHEN c.age BETWEEN 26 AND 35 THEN '26-35岁' WHEN c.age BETWEEN 36 AND 45 THEN '36-45岁' ELSE '46岁及以上' END AS age_group, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY age_group ORDER BY age_group
notes: CASE WHEN 分桶 + 去重客户数；gold 4 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品类的商品数量、平均标价和销售额分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH product_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category), sales AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS sales_amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT ps.category, ps.product_count, ROUND(ps.avg_price, 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(COALESCE(s.sales_amount, 0), 2) AS sales_amount FROM product_stats ps LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.category = ps.category ORDER BY sales_amount DESC
notes: 平均标价必须先在商品表算（COUNT/AVG），否则 join 明细后会被销量加权；销售额另路聚合再对齐；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月消费金额最高的 10 位客户是谁？显示客户姓名、城市和消费金额。
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, c.city, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name, c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 客户维度 Top10，按 customer_id 兜底排序避免同名并列；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月退货件数最多的 10 个商品是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned_units FROM returns r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.return_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY returned_units DESC, p.product_id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 退货件数口径；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各会员等级客户的订单数和 GMV 分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 会员等级维度双指标；gold 4 行。

question: 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年 9 月，每个月的 GMV 是多少？按月排列。
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
notes: 近 12 个月趋势，monotonic 月份排序；gold 12 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的 GMV 同比去年 9 月增长了多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT channel, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date LIKE '2026-09%' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_current, SUM(CASE WHEN order_date LIKE '2025-09%' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_prev FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND (order_date LIKE '2026-09%' OR order_date LIKE '2025-09%') GROUP BY channel) SELECT channel, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv_current - gmv_prev) / gmv_prev, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM agg ORDER BY yoy_pct DESC
notes: 条件聚合做同比；gold 只输出问题要的渠道+同比%，不附带本期/去年同期绝对值；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月的整体 GMV 相比 8 月环比增长了多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN order_date LIKE '2026-09%' THEN total_amount END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_date LIKE '2026-08%' THEN total_amount END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN order_date LIKE '2026-08%' THEN total_amount END), 2) AS mom_pct FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND (order_date LIKE '2026-09%' OR order_date LIKE '2026-08%')
notes: 题面只问环比增速，gold 只返回 1 列；gold 1 行。

question: 2026 年 4 月到 9 月，每个月的已完成订单量和环比增长率分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month), lagged AS (SELECT month, orders, LAG(orders) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_orders FROM monthly) SELECT month, orders, ROUND(100.0 * (orders - prev_orders) / prev_orders, 2) AS mom_pct FROM lagged WHERE month >= '2026-04' ORDER BY month
notes: 4 月环比要用 3 月做基数，所以 CTE 多取一个月；LAG 必须在过滤前的 CTE 里算，否则 4 月会得 NULL；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 4 月到 9 月，每个月发生的退货单数占当月完成订单数的比例是多少（百分比）？退货按发生月份归属。
gold_sql: WITH m_orders AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month), m_returns AS (SELECT substr(return_date, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(*) AS return_orders FROM returns WHERE return_date >= '2026-04-01' AND return_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month) SELECT o.month, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.return_orders, 0) / o.completed_orders, 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM m_orders o LEFT JOIN m_returns r ON r.month = o.month ORDER BY o.month
notes: 题面问的是退货单数（returns 一行一单），不能去重到订单；LEFT JOIN + COALESCE 防止某些月无退货；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品类的 GMV 同比去年 9 月增长了多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category), prev AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-09%' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT cur.category, ROUND(100.0 * (cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / prev.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM cur JOIN prev ON prev.category = cur.category ORDER BY yoy_pct DESC
notes: 两路 CTE 算本期/同期后只输出品类+同比%；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年第一季度、第二季度、第三季度的 GMV 分别是多少？季度请用 Q1、Q2、Q3 标注。
gold_sql: SELECT 'Q' || ((CAST(substr(order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter
notes: TEXT 日期做季度分桶；题面已写死标签格式；gold 3 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月最后 7 天（9 月 24 日至 30 日）每天的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT order_date, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-24' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date
notes: 日粒度趋势；gold 7 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的 GMV 从高到低排名，给出名次、渠道和 GMV。
gold_sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_amount) DESC) AS rnk, channel, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 聚合后窗口排名；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品类的 GMV、排名，以及占当月整体 GMV 的比例（百分比）分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT category, gmv, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gmv DESC) AS rnk, ROUND(100.0 * gmv / SUM(gmv) OVER (), 2) AS share_pct FROM cat ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: RANK + SUM() OVER () 算占比；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年 4 月到 9 月，每月的 GMV 以及截至当月的累计 GMV 分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2026-04-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS monthly_gmv, ROUND(SUM(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_gmv FROM monthly ORDER BY month
notes: 窗口累计求和；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月销量最高的 5 个城市中，每个城市销量最高的 3 个商品及其销量分别是什么？
gold_sql: WITH city_sales AS (SELECT c.city, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY qty DESC, c.city ASC LIMIT 5), product_city AS (SELECT c.city, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.city, p.product_id, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT city, product_name, qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY qty DESC, product_name ASC) AS rn FROM product_city) SELECT r.city, r.product_name, r.qty FROM ranked r JOIN city_sales cs ON cs.city = r.city WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY cs.qty DESC, r.city, r.rn
notes: 两层排名：先城市 Top5 再城市内商品 Top3；题面明确要销量列；gold 15 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品类销售额排名前 5 的商品（每个品类最多 5 个）分别是哪些？给出品类、商品名称和销售额。
gold_sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_id, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT category, product_name, amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY amount DESC, product_name ASC) AS rn FROM product_sales) SELECT category, product_name, ROUND(amount, 2) AS sales_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY category, rn
notes: PARTITION BY 品类取 Top5；题面明确三列输出；gold 不超过 40 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月消费金额最高的 10 位客户，给出排名、姓名、消费金额及其占当月总 GMV 的比例（百分比）。
gold_sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name), total AS (SELECT SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv FROM cust) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cust.gmv DESC) AS rnk, cust.name, ROUND(cust.gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * cust.gmv / total.total_gmv, 2) AS share_pct FROM cust CROSS JOIN total ORDER BY cust.gmv DESC, cust.customer_id ASC LIMIT 10
notes: RANK 窗口 + 总量 CROSS JOIN；gold 10 行。

question: 2026 年 1 月至 8 月完成的订单中，按订单口径的退货率和按金额口径的退款占比分别是多少（百分比）？退货单含处理中状态。
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31'), r AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS return_orders, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * r.return_orders / o.completed_orders, 2) AS return_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * r.refund / o.gmv, 2) AS refund_ratio_pct FROM o CROSS JOIN r
notes: 订单口径用 COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)；题面只要两个比例，gold 只返回 2 列；选 1-8 月避免 9 月订单来不及退货；gold 1 行。

question: 2026 年 1 月至 8 月各品类的退货率（按退货件数占销售件数的比例）分别是多少（百分比）？退货件数含处理中状态，退货按原订单月份归属。
gold_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS sold FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.category), ret AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned FROM returns r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT s.category, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.returned, 0) / s.sold, 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.category = s.category ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC
notes: 商品件数口径，退货按原订单月份归属；题面写死归属和状态；gold 只输出品类+比例；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的客单价和客单件数分别是多少？
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT order_id, channel, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%'), i AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(i.qty) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS units_per_order FROM o JOIN i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY aov DESC
notes: 先聚合明细再 join，避免一单多行导致金额重复累加；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 1 月至 8 月，退货率最高的五个商品是哪些？统计口径：退货按原订单月份归属，退货件数含处理中，销量至少 10 件。
gold_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS sold FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name HAVING SUM(i.quantity) >= 10), ret AS (SELECT r.product_id, SUM(r.quantity) AS returned FROM returns r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY r.product_id) SELECT s.product_name, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.returned, 0) / s.sold, 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.product_id = s.product_id ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, s.product_id ASC LIMIT 5
notes: HAVING 卡最低销量避免 1 单 1 退的 100% 噪声；退货按原订单月份归属；gold 只输出商品+退货率；gold 5 行。

question: 2026 年以来各投放渠道的 ROI（归因 GMV 除以预算）是多少？按 ROI 从高到低排列。
gold_sql: WITH campaign_gmv AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.channel, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(g.gmv), 0) / SUM(c.budget), 2) AS roi FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN campaign_gmv g ON g.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.start_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY c.channel ORDER BY roi DESC
notes: 预算与归因 GMV 分别聚合后相除；题面只要 ROI，gold 只输出渠道+ROI；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 7 月到 9 月，每个月的 GMV、环比增速和同比增速分别是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY month), lagged AS (SELECT month, gmv, LAG(gmv) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_1, LAG(gmv, 12) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_12 FROM monthly) SELECT month, ROUND(gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - prev_1) / prev_1, 2) AS mom_pct, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv - prev_12) / prev_12, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM lagged WHERE month >= '2026-07' ORDER BY month
notes: 同一 CTE 同时 LAG(1) 和 LAG(12)；窗口必须在过滤前的 CTE 算，否则 7 月的同比会为空；gold 3 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各品类的 GMV、同比增速，以及当月发生的退款金额（含处理中的退货单）占该品类 GMV 的比例分别是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category), prev AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS gmv FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-09%' GROUP BY p.category), ref AS (SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns r JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id WHERE r.return_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category) SELECT cur.category, ROUND(cur.gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / prev.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ref.refund, 0) / cur.gmv, 2) AS refund_ratio_pct FROM cur JOIN prev ON prev.category = cur.category LEFT JOIN ref ON ref.category = cur.category ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 三路 CTE 分别算本期/同期/当月退款，再对齐；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月各销售渠道的 GMV、订单数、客单价，以及当月发生的退款金额（含处理中的退货单）占 GMV 的比例分别是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY channel), r AS (SELECT o.channel, SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund FROM returns r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND r.return_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY o.channel) SELECT o.channel, ROUND(o.gmv, 2) AS gmv, o.orders, ROUND(o.gmv / o.orders, 2) AS aov, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(r.refund, 0) / o.gmv, 2) AS refund_ratio_pct FROM o LEFT JOIN r ON r.channel = o.channel ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 渠道多维指标一次性对齐；gold 6 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月消费金额前 10 的客户合计贡献了多少 GMV？占当月总 GMV 的比例是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH cust AS (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT SUM(gmv) AS top_gmv FROM (SELECT gmv FROM cust ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT ROUND((SELECT top_gmv FROM top10), 2) AS top10_gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT top_gmv FROM top10) / (SELECT SUM(gmv) FROM cust), 2) AS top10_share_pct
notes: 先算客户级 GMV 再取 Top10 汇总；题面只要 Top10 合计与占比，gold 只返回 2 列；gold 1 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月的新客和老客分别有多少位客户、贡献多少 GMV、客单价是多少？（新客指首笔已完成订单发生在 2026 年 9 月的客户；客单价按订单口径 = GMV ÷ 已完成订单数）
gold_sql: WITH first_order AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY customer_id), sep AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT CASE WHEN f.first_date LIKE '2026-09%' THEN '新客' ELSE '老客' END AS customer_type, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(s.gmv), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(s.gmv) / SUM(s.orders), 2) AS aov FROM sep s JOIN first_order f ON f.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY customer_type ORDER BY gmv DESC
notes: 新客定义=首笔已完成订单落在 9 月（含已取消首单不算新客）；客单价按订单口径，题面已写死；gold 2 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月每个品类销量第一的商品是哪个？销量是多少？
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS qty FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_id, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT category, product_name, qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY qty DESC, product_name ASC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT category, product_name, qty FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category
notes: 品类内销量 Top1，8 个品类；gold 8 行。

question: 2026 年以来投入产出比最高的 5 个投放计划是哪些？给出计划名称、预算、归因 GMV 和 ROI。
gold_sql: WITH campaign_gmv AS (SELECT campaign_id, SUM(total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' AND order_date LIKE '2026%' GROUP BY campaign_id) SELECT c.campaign_name, ROUND(c.budget, 2) AS budget, ROUND(COALESCE(g.gmv, 0), 2) AS attributed_gmv, ROUND(COALESCE(g.gmv, 0) / c.budget, 2) AS roi FROM campaigns c LEFT JOIN campaign_gmv g ON g.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.start_date LIKE '2026%' ORDER BY roi DESC, c.campaign_id ASC LIMIT 5
notes: 计划粒度 ROI Top5；注意预算不能和订单行相乘；gold 5 行。

question: 2026 年 9 月 GMV 最高的 10 个城市，各自的 GMV 和同比去年 9 月的增速分别是多少（百分比）？
gold_sql: WITH cur AS (SELECT c.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09%' GROUP BY c.city), prev AS (SELECT c.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-09%' GROUP BY c.city) SELECT cur.city, ROUND(cur.gmv, 2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / prev.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct FROM cur JOIN prev ON prev.city = cur.city ORDER BY gmv DESC, cur.city ASC LIMIT 10
notes: 城市 GMV Top10 叠同比；gold 10 行。
